name: Know when this workflow stops running

parameters.content:
## Know when this workflow stops running

### How it works

This workflow runs on an hourly schedule, executes the placeholder work step, and then sends a GET request to Silent Fail to report that the workflow completed successfully. It is intended as a monitoring pattern so Silent Fail can alert you if the workflow stops running or fails before the final ping.

### Setup steps

- Configure the schedule trigger if hourly execution is not the desired interval.
- Replace the placeholder "Your work goes here" node with the actual workflow steps you want to monitor.
- Update the HTTP Request node with your full Silent Fail ping URL, including the correct token or monitor identifier.

### Customization

You can change the schedule frequency, add real processing nodes between the trigger and the final ping, or point the HTTP Request node to a different uptime/heartbeat monitoring service.

## Run work and ping

A single linear cluster that starts the workflow every hour, runs the monitored work placeholder, and sends a completion heartbeat to Silent Fail.
